name: pace-website
description: PACE Consultant website — static site (root) + Next.js app (pace-consultant-nextjs)

scripts.dev:all: npx --yes concurrently -n "static,nextjs" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:static" "npm run dev:next"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix pace-consultant-nextjs && npm run build --prefix pace-consultant-nextjs
